findings.quote: Ionic compounds have no separate molecules. Their written formula, such as $NaCl$, is the simplest ion ratio, so it is already an empirical formula.
findings.problem: A simplest ion ratio is not always a simplest atom ratio. NIST lists sodium peroxide as Na2O2. Applying the empirical-formula definition gives NaO. The general claim is false.
